shareText:
Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir (French: Miraculous, les aventures de Ladybug et Chat Noir) is a globally acclaimed CGI-animated superhero television series created by Thomas Astruc and developed by Jeremy Zag. First premiering in 2015, the show is produced by Miraculous Corp (a joint venture between Mediawan and ZAG Entertainment) in collaboration with Toei Animation. 

🎬 The Core Premise

Set in modern-day Paris, the series follows two seemingly ordinary teenagers: Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste. When evil arises, they use magical jewelled objects known as Miraculouses (and their companion creatures, the Kwamis) to transform into the superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir.

The Love Square: Unbeknownst to each other, they are classmates and mutual crushes. Marinette is deeply infatuated with Adrien, while Cat Noir is in love with Ladybug. Neither knows the other's secret identity, creating the show's signature dramatic tension. 
The Antagonist: Their main adversary is Hawk Moth (who later evolves into Shadow Moth and Monarch). He exploits the negative emotions of everyday Parisian citizens, using butterfly-like akumas to transform them into malicious supervillains in an ongoing effort to steal Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses.

🎥Rockstar
Rockstar is not just a love story - it’s the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.
What starts as a chaotic college romance slowly becomes an emotional storm of love, separation, fame, and loneliness. Heer, played by Nargis Fakhri, becomes the soul of Jordan’s music and madness.
Unlike typical romantic films, Rockstar shows how love can heal and destroy someone at the same time.
The movie became unforgettable because of its raw emotions, deep dialogues, magical music by A. R. Rahman, and Ranbir Kapoor’s career-defining performance. Every song feels like a memory you never lived but somehow still miss.
